```{r}
#Per Gestire il problema dei NA li sostitutiamo con "unknown"
mtbDt = readRDS("../data/metabolomics/mtbDt5vs6_Pz_adjusted.rds")
smpDt = readRDS("../data/metabolomics/smpDt5vs6_Pz_adjusted.rds")
smpDt_ord <- smpDt[order(smpDt$pzID), ]
mtbDt_ord <- mtbDt[row.names(smpDt_ord), , drop = FALSE]
```

```{r}
# --- pacchetti ---
library(vegan)     # adonis2, vegdist
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

# ----------------------------
# 1) prepara matrice metaboliti
# ----------------------------
X <- as.data.frame(mtbDt_ord)

# rimuovi feature con varianza nulla o tutte NA
nzv <- sapply(X, function(v) sd(v, na.rm = TRUE) > 0)
X   <- X[, nzv, drop = FALSE]

# log1p (robusto a zeri)
X <- log1p(X)

# imputa NA con mediana di colonna (semplice e robusto)
for (j in seq_len(ncol(X))) {
  v <- X[[j]]
  if (anyNA(v)) X[[j]][is.na(v)] <- median(v, na.rm = TRUE)
}

# standardizza (media=0, sd=1) per feature
Xz <- scale(X)

# ----------------------------
# 2) PCoA su distanza Euclidea
# ----------------------------
D  <- dist(Xz, method = "euclidean")
cmd <- cmdscale(D, k = 2, eig = TRUE)

# % varianza spiegata dagli assi
eig <- cmd$eig[cmd$eig > 0]
var_exp <- eig / sum(eig)
pc1_var <- percent(var_exp[1])
pc2_var <- percent(var_exp[2])

# dataframe per il plot
grp <- factor(smpDt_ord$`GROUP IGA`, levels = c("5","6"),
              labels = c("Pre-Bariatric Surgery","Post-Bariatric Surgery"))
pcoa_df <- data.frame(PC1 = cmd$points[,1],
                      PC2 = cmd$points[,2],
                      group = grp)

# ----------------------------
# 3) PERMANOVA (999 permutazioni)
# ----------------------------
perm <- adonis2(D ~ group, data = data.frame(group = grp),
                permutations = 999, by = "terms")

R2 <- unname(perm$R2[1])
pv <- unname(perm$`Pr(>F)`[1])

# ----------------------------
# 4) Plot PCoA
# ----------------------------
gg_pcoa <- ggplot(pcoa_df, aes(PC1, PC2, color = group)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.8, alpha = 0.9) +
  # opzionale: ellissi per gruppo
  stat_ellipse(level = 0.68, linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.6) +
  labs(
    x = paste0("PCoA1 (", pc1_var, ")"),
    y = paste0("PCoA2 (", pc2_var, ")"),
    color = NULL,
    title = " ",
    subtitle = sprintf("PERMANOVA: R² = %.3f, p = %.4f (999 perms)", R2, pv)
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

print(gg_pcoa)
ggsave("../results/metabolomics/PCoA_metabolomicsBariatricSurgery.png", gg_pcoa, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 600)
```

```{r}
metdiffpath = "../results/metabolomics/DifferentialAnalysis/TtestMetabolomic.xlsx"

metAll = as.data.frame(mtbDt_ord)
metAll$groupIGA = as.factor(smpDt_ord$`GROUP IGA`)

cmps = c()
tpval = c()
nTot = c()
nNom = c()
meanNom = c()
stNom = c()
nDen = c()
meanDen = c()
stDen = c()
logFc = c()

nom = "6"
den = "5"

meTmp = metAll[metAll$groupIGA %in% c(nom, den),]

for (cmp in colnames(metAll)) {
  if (!cmp %in% "groupIGA") {

    test_result <- NULL

    ## ======== CAMBIO MINIMO: usa la versione a due vettori per 'paired' ========
    tryCatch({
      nomVec <- meTmp[meTmp$groupIGA == nom, cmp]
      denVec <- meTmp[meTmp$groupIGA == den, cmp]

      # opzionale ma sicuro: se le lunghezze non coincidono, metti NA
      if (length(nomVec) != length(denVec)) stop("Vettori non allineati per il paired")

      test_result <- wilcox.test(nomVec, denVec, paired = TRUE)
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("Error in processing column", cmp, ": ", e$message, "\n")
    })
    ## ===========================================================================
    
    if (!is.null(test_result)) {
      tpval = append(tpval, test_result$p.value)
    } else {
      tpval = append(tpval, NA)  # Se c'è un errore, metti NA
    }

    cmps   = append(cmps, cmp)
    nTot   = append(nTot, nrow(meTmp))

    nomTmp   = meTmp[meTmp[,"groupIGA"] == nom,]
    nNom     = append(nNom, nrow(nomTmp))
    meanNom  = append(meanNom, mean(nomTmp[,cmp]))
    stNom    = append(stNom,   sd(nomTmp[,cmp]))

    denTmp   = meTmp[meTmp[,"groupIGA"] == den,]
    nDen     = append(nDen, nrow(denTmp))
    meanDen  = append(meanDen, mean(denTmp[,cmp]))
    stDen    = append(stDen,   sd(denTmp[,cmp]))

    lfc      = (mean(nomTmp[,cmp]) - mean(denTmp[,cmp]))
    logFc    = append(logFc, lfc)
  }
}

tpval = as.numeric(tpval)
fdr   = p.adjust(tpval, method = "fdr")
logFct = log2(abs(logFc))
logFc  = (logFc)

res = cbind(cmps,nTot, nNom,meanNom, stNom, nDen, meanDen, stDen,logFc, tpval, fdr)
res = as.data.frame(res)
colnames(res) = c("cmps", "n",paste0("n_",nom), paste0("mean_",nom), paste0("StDev_",nom),
                  paste0("n_",den), paste0("mean_",den), paste0("StDev",den),
                  "logFc", "p-value", "fdr")

# pulizia p-value non numerici
res = res[!is.na(as.numeric(res$`p-value`)), ]
res = res[order(as.numeric(res$`p-value`)), ]

# xlsx::write.xlsx(res,metdiffpath, sheetName = var,  append = TRUE)

res$log2FC <- log2(
  (as.numeric(res[[paste0("mean_", nom)]]) + 1e-6) /
  (as.numeric(res[[paste0("mean_", den)]]) + 1e-6)
)

res
View(res)

```






```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

# Assumiamo che res sia già un data.frame con colonne "cmps", "logFc", "fdr"
df <- res
df$logFc <- as.numeric(as.character(df$log2FC))
df$fdr   <- as.numeric(as.character(df$fdr))

alpha <- 0.05
df$negLogFDR <- -log10(df$fdr)
df$Signif <- ifelse(df$fdr <= alpha, "Significant", "Not Significant")

# Volcano plot
p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = logFc, y = negLogFDR, color = Signif)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Not Significant" = "grey70",
                                "Significant" = "red")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(alpha), linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "Volcano plot - Metabolomics",
    x = paste0("log2 Fold Change (", nom, " vs ", den, ")"),
    y = "-log10(FDR)",
    color = ""
  )

# Etichette su tutti i significativi
p <- p + ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
  data = subset(df, fdr <= alpha),
  aes(label = cmps),
  size = 3,
  max.overlaps = 50,
  box.padding = 0.4,
  show.legend = FALSE
)

print(p)

# Se vuoi salvare:
# ggsave("volcano_metabolomics.png", p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)

```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

# Assumiamo che res sia già un data.frame con colonne "cmps", "logFc", "fdr"
df <- res
df$logFc <- as.numeric(as.character(df$log2FC))
df$fdr   <- as.numeric(as.character(df$fdr))

alpha <- 0.05
df$negLogFDR <- -log10(df$fdr)
df$Signif <- ifelse(df$fdr <= alpha, "Significant", "Not Significant")

# >>> AGGIUNTA: categoria colore in base a direzione e significatività
df$DirCat <- ifelse(df$fdr <= alpha & df$logFc > 0, "Up",
               ifelse(df$fdr <= alpha & df$logFc < 0, "Down", "Not Significant"))

# Volcano plot
p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = logFc, y = negLogFDR, color = DirCat)) +  # <<< cambiato: color = DirCat
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Not Significant" = "grey70",
                                "Up" = "blue",
                                "Down" = "red")) +                 # <<< mappa colori richiesta
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(alpha), linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "Volcano plot - Metabolomics",
    x = paste0("log2 Fold Change (", nom, " vs ", den, ")"),
    y = "-log10(FDR)",
    color = ""
  )

# Etichette su tutti i significativi
p <- p + ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
  data = subset(df, fdr <= alpha),
  aes(label = cmps),
  size = 3,
  max.overlaps = 50,
  box.padding = 0.4,
  show.legend = FALSE
)

print(p)
ggsave("../results/metabolomics/volcano_metabolomicsBariatricSurgery.png", p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 600)

```
